messages.subject: Heatmap with Bounding box.
parts:
Hi guys,

I want to produce a bounding box for the following heatmap:

# Construct data.frame.
Nv <- 100; n <- 100; mat <- matrix(0,n,Nv);
for(i in 1:Nv){ mat[,i] <- rnorm(n)}; W <- cor(mat)
df <- cbind(expand.grid(1:Nv,1:Nv),as.vector(W)); names(df) <-
c("x","y","w")

# Change default in old_them.
old_theme <-
theme_update(panel.grid.minor=theme_blank(),panel.grid.major=theme_blank(),

panel.background=theme_blank(),axis.title.x=theme_blank(),axis.title.y=theme_blank())

# Data for geom_path to draw bounding box.
heat <- ggplot(data=df,aes(x=x,y=y,fill=w)) + geom_tile() +
opts(legend.position="none") +
scale_x_continuous(breaks=NA) +
scale_y_reverse(breaks=NA) +

scale_fill_gradient(limits=range(W),low=colorscale[1],high=colorscale[2])
heat

I simply would like to add a square around the heatmap. I have tried
several things but without success. What is the best way to tackle
this problem.

Thank you very much for your help,

Cedric

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Heatmap with Bounding box.
parts:
hi,

here is an example:

heat<-ggplot(data=df,aes(x=x,y=y,fill=w))+geom_tile()+opts(legend.position="none",panel.border=theme_rect(size=5))+scale_x_continuous(breaks=NA,expand=c(0,0))+scale_y_reverse(breaks=NA,expand=c(0,0))+scale_fill_gradient(limits=range(W))

the tricks are panel.border in opts() and expand in scale_{x,y}.
